flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8001/login then Type {{global.account1_email}} in the Email field.
Type {{secrets.user.account1_password}} in the Password field.
Click 'Log in'.

Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8001/appointments/new then Select 'Aisha Rahman' in the Patient dropdown.
Set the Date field to 3 March 2025.
Set the Time field to 10:30.
Type 'Inhaler review' in the Reason field.
Click 'Book appointment'.
Store what the page shows after that as 'what_happened'.
Verify that the page still shows the Book appointment form with an error saying the date is in the past, and the appointment was not saved.
